facts.text: Creekside sits just 12 miles northeast of downtown Louisville, offering a quiet suburban feel close to the city.
Creekside is a home‑rule‑class city, giving it local governance autonomy within Jefferson County, while still being part of the larger metro area.
Creekside’s town hall is located at PO Box 221076 in Louisville and can be reached at (502) 429‑5380.
Planning a construction project in Creekside? First step is obtaining permits through the city’s Building Department.
For online services and municipal information, visit Creekside’s official website at creeksidecity.com, where residents can access forms and updates.
Creekside is bordered to the south by the neighboring community of Hickory Hill, while the rest of its perimeter is surrounded by Louisville’s metro government.
